SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(customer_id AS CHAR) AS owner, state, CAST(payable_minor AS CHAR) AS payableMinor, CAST(coupon_id AS CHAR) AS couponId, expires_at AS expiresAt, version FROM sales_order WHERE id=CAST(#{orderId} AS UNSIGNED) FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM payment WHERE order_id=CAST(#{orderId} AS UNSIGNED) AND state IN ('CREATED','PROCESSING','SUCCEEDED') ORDER BY id LIMIT 2
